svg.title: Fix one finite lattice (V, E), connected as a graph, with Z = GV × GE, U = GE and π, σ as in Theorem 7.1. Two groups act on Z: the frame group GV by k · (r, A) = (kr, (kxAek−1 y )e), and the lifted gauge group GV by (r, A) · h = ((rxh−1 x )x, A). The two actions commute. Let E be the action groupoid of GV frame × GV gauge on Z, and Comp the action groupoid of the gauge group on U, (h · U)e = hxUeh−1 y . These are the groupoids of realized histories and of allowed comparison isomorphisms on this branch.
